target_customer: Merchants and companies that lose revenue to payment chargebacks, in Latin America
problem: Merchants lose money to chargebacks and lack automated dispute handling and monitoring.

founders.name: Pablo Rojas
founders.background_notes: YC page: led onboarding and KYC for Latin America at Rappi Bank and helped structure its chargeback reconciliation.

competitors.name: Justt
competitors.traction_then: Came out of stealth in November 2021
competitors.funding_then: 70 million dollars total including a 50 million Series B

technical_complexity.rationale: Integrations with payment processors and dispute workflows are routine engineering for a small team.

defensibility.rationale: Processor integrations create some lock-in but rivals with more funding could copy the workflow.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source found on the effect of rivals on Protego.

market_need_then: Chargebacks are a known merchant cost and the founder worked on chargeback reconciliation at Rappi Bank; no dated market figures were found.

brand_strength.rationale: No brand coverage found; several unrelated companies share the name.

outcome_analysis: Protego was a five person chargeback automation startup in Bogota that took a small YC investment in 2021 and is listed Inactive. No shutdown notice or post-mortem was found, so the cause of inactivity is not public and no failure factors are recorded.
notes: No company website listed. The 130K figure rests on CB Insights; Descubre and Village report about 125K labeled pre-seed or seed, conflicting stage labels, so the stage is recorded as other. Amounts of 2 million on Fundable and Raising.fi belong to a different Protego. Justt source is dated three months after the batch.
